decisions.reason: After two years without website visibility, this close-to-core line likely fell below aspiration levels and the firm would redeploy craft capacity to stronger core seasonal items or newer development.

Although it fits established pyramid capabilities, its prolonged absence suggests this specific variant no longer clears aspiration thresholds relative to other core products, so management would discontinue it.

The flagship electronic music box was given time because of slack and strategic intent, but by 2022 its nonappearance points to underperformance versus aspirations and a poor fit with the firm's traditional resource base.
As a distant complement dependent on the electronic music box system, it is unlikely to justify itself once that platform appears not to have met aspirations, making withdrawal highly likely.
Even with some thematic fit to the firm's Christmas strengths, this accessory depends on the same distant music-box platform and would likely be cut after extended weak visibility and limited slack.
